name: azure-sre-agent-demo
description: An Azure SRE Agent with a scoped Container Apps workload, Application Insights, Log Analytics, synthetic availability monitoring, and guarded operational runbooks.
what: An Azure SRE Agent and disposable Container Apps workload with three idle replicas, HTTPS ingress, centralized telemetry, a multi-location availability test, and an Azure Monitor alert. The agent uses a dedicated managed identity with access limited to the demo resource group.
why: Teams evaluating agentic operations need a safe, repeatable environment that demonstrates incident response, FinOps analysis, and configuration hardening without granting an autonomous agent subscription-wide access or targeting production services.
potentialUseCases: Autonomous investigation and recovery from a Container App availability incident
Utilization-based Container Apps right-sizing and cost optimization
Detection and correction of insecure HTTP ingress
SRE Agent workshops, evaluations, and operational governance reviews

reliability: Azure Monitor alert provides a deterministic incident trigger
Every scenario includes post-action verification and an idempotent reset
security: Autonomous access is constrained to the disposable demo resource group
Runbooks prohibit deletion, role changes, Key Vault access, and out-of-scope writes
costOptimization: Three idle replicas create a visible right-sizing opportunity
Consumption-based Container Apps avoid fixed compute infrastructure
The complete environment has a single resource-group cleanup boundary
operationalExcellence: Log Analytics and Application Insights centralize workload and agent evidence
Stable alert naming supports repeatable Azure Monitor response plans
Documented trigger and reset controls make demonstrations reproducible
performanceEfficiency: HTTP concurrency scaling remains available above the baseline replica floor
The cost scenario uses measured CPU, memory, requests, and replica data
Bounded min/max replica settings prevent uncontrolled scaling

quota.summary: Requires Azure Container Apps and Azure SRE Agent availability in the selected region. Agent deployment also requires an Entra administrator group and permission to create resource-group role assignments.

requirements.detail: The managed environment must be available in the target region.
The subscription must be registered for Azure SRE Agent and the selected region must be available.

cost.profile: Workshop profile with three continuously available 0.5-vCPU, 1-GiB replicas. Azure SRE Agent AAU charges are separate and are not included.

components.name: Container Apps vCPU (active)
components.notes: Three replicas x 0.5 vCPU x 730 hours x 3600 seconds.

components.name: Container Apps memory (active)
components.notes: Three replicas x 1 GiB x 730 hours x 3600 seconds.

components.name: Log Analytics analytics logs ingestion
components.notes: Assumes approximately 2 GB of workshop telemetry per month. SRE Agent consumption uses separate AAU billing.
